question: Who abides in the supreme Sadakhya world and what level follows above the bindu sequence?
premises: In that world abides one whose great body consists of the five mantras.
That presence is in a supreme form.
Above the bindu sequence ending with half-moon and obstruction comes the great Nada.
inference: Sadakhya is the abode of the five-mantra supreme form, and beyond the bindu sequence the great Nada appears.
uncertainties: The compound in the last token is dense, so the exact boundaries of the summarized sequence are interpretive.
plain_english: There abides, in supreme form, the one whose great body is made of the five mantras. Thus, above the bindu sequence that extends through the half-moon and the obstructing level, comes the great Nada.
